summary: The document defines classes and methods for handling print job report parameters within the HSPnet system.
purpose: To manage and process parameters related to print jobs in the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: PrintJobPRDList
steps: Retrieve all parameters for the given PrintJobID using PrintJobGetAllParameters.
Check if the parameter name is PRD_ID and append its value to the return string.
Delete the print job using PrintJobDelete.

workflows.name: PrintJobGetAllParameters
steps: Set the stored procedure name to PrintJobGetAllParameters.
Execute the stored procedure to get data.
Read through the data and create PrintJobReportParameter objects for each.
Add each parameter object to a list.

system_behavior: Executes stored procedures to retrieve parameter data.
